paper.title_en: Topological Integer-Winding Dark Matter: Stability from $π_2(\mathrm{SU}(3)/\mathrm{SO}(3)) = \mathbb{Z}$
paper.abstract_en: We propose a dark matter model in which the symmetry-breaking pattern SU(3)_dark -> SO(3)_dark x Z_2 produces absolutely stable point-like topological defects classified by pi_2(SU(3)/[SO(3) x Z_2]) = Z. The lightest neutral member chi^0 of the resulting dark octet couples to Standard Model fields only through a kinetic-mixing portal (g_f = 10^-3) and gravity. An extended Gell-Mann-Okubo mass operator incorporating the quantum number darkicity T_dark predicts two scale-independent mass ratios, r_21 = M(chi^++)/M(chi^0) = 1.042 +/- 0.003 and r_31 = M(Sigma^0_dark)/M(chi^0) = 0.809 +/- 0.004, falsifiable at FCC-ee. Eight coupled Boltzmann equations with co-annihilation yield Omega_DM h^2 = 0.120 at M_0 = 150 GeV. Self-interaction cross-sections satisfy all astrophysical bounds from dwarf galaxies to the Bullet Cluster. The model predicts a stochastic gravitational-wave background at f_* = 1.65 mHz (LISA, SNR = 8.5) and dark acoustic oscillations at r_DAO = 2.3 +/- 0.4 Mpc (SKA).

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以拓扑缺陷（π₂(SU(3)/SO(3))=ℤ）构造绝对稳定的暗物质模型，涉及对称性破缺、扩展Gell-Mann-Okubo质量算符、八耦合Boltzmann方程等较深的场论与粒子物理理论构造，理论深度较高；同时给出可证伪的质量比、自相互作用截面、随机引力波背景与暗声振荡等定量预言，方法学信号较强。虽然主类与全息凝聚态关联有限，但拓扑缺陷与对称性破缺分类的主题接近，且首阶段命中随机引力波背景，故值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 拓扑整数缠绕暗物质：来自 $π_2(\mathrm{SU}(3)/\mathrm{SO}(3)) = \mathbb{Z}$ 的稳定性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个暗物质模型，其中对称性破缺模式 SU(3)_dark → SO(3)_dark × Z_2 产生由 pi_2(SU(3)/[SO(3) × Z_2]) = Z 分类的绝对稳定的点状拓扑缺陷。所得暗八重态中最轻的中性成员 chi^0 仅通过动能混合门户（g_f = 10^-3）和引力与标准模型场耦合。一个包含量子数 darkicity T_dark 的扩展 Gell-Mann-Okubo 质量算符预言了两个与尺度无关的质量比，r_21 = M(chi^++)/M(chi^0) = 1.042 ± 0.003 和 r_31 = M(Sigma^0_dark)/M(chi^0) = 0.809 ± 0.004，可在 FCC-ee 上被证伪。包含共湮灭的八个耦合 Boltzmann 方程在 M_0 = 150 GeV 时给出 Omega_DM h^2 = 0.120。自相互作用截面满足从矮星系到子弹星团的所有天体物理界限。该模型预言了在 f_* = 1.65 mHz 处的随机引力波背景（LISA，SNR = 8.5）以及在 r_DAO = 2.3 ± 0.4 Mpc 处的暗声振荡（SKA）。
